purpose: Test lightweight multimodal fusion of all registered post-ID341 material matrices against ID342.

research_priors.read: Q1/S3 were strongest with 3-hour step-count features, Q2/Q3 with daily mobile app usage, and demographics/weekday helped across models.
The challenge exposes multimodal smartphone, wearable, proximity, GPS, light, app, and sleep-related lifelog streams for the seven Q/S targets.

decision.reason: Registered material fusion did not clear the strict ID342/Public-0.55 local gate.
